financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of ADSs and non-voting ordinary shares, closed July 17, 2023 (incl. full option exercise)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The transaction resulted in gross proceeds to the Company of $230.0 million, and after deducting underwriting discounts, commissions, and estimated offering expenses of $14.5 million, net proceeds to the Company of approximately $215.5 million.
